decisions.reason: The LED model, LCSC number, manufacturer, package, dimensions, mounting, and color channels are already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The assembly BOM already has a same-message MODIFY containing the complete selected LED part and package details, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Selecting the addressable LED part does not change the panel reset connector, mounting, or electrical action.
The selected LED component does not change the sensor-board connector matrix or connector count.
The LED part selection does not affect the SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The PIR connector requirement remains valid unchanged by the LED component selection.
The LED model and package do not alter the panel GPIO button or switch interfaces.
The addressable LED part selection has no effect on the TTP223 touch connectors or GPIO assignments.
The source identifies the part under the LED-board discussion and does not necessarily change the separate charge-status indication path or its connector and resistor configuration.
Choosing a specific SK6812MINI-E part does not change the switched 5V rail's control, capacity, loads, or independent LED power control.
The LED component selection does not modify any interboard signal connector or pinout.
The selected LED part does not alter the interboard power topology, connector type, or power pinout.
